C0261.title: Administrative Detention for Funneling Followers to Telecom Fraud Gangs
C0261.summary: Zhang from Jiaxiang County, Shandong, took a part-time job through a browser ad to pull people into QQ groups. Following instructions from an upstream telecom fraud gang, he lured individuals into groups and induced them to download and register information-stealing software, earning 8 to 20 yuan per follower. Zhang has been placed under administrative detention.

references.title: Helping telecom fraud gangs 'attract followers and generate traffic' is a crime
